description: Tiles several occurences of an input image while adding randomness.

inputs.description: The input image or atlas of 4 or 16 input images
inputs.name: in

inputs.description: The mask applied to the pattern
inputs.name: mask

instance: vec4 tiler_$(name)(vec2 uv, vec2 tile, int overlap, vec2 _seed, out vec3 random_color, float _seed_variation_, vec4 _controlled_variation_) {
vec2 pos = uv*tile+vec2(float(dx), float(dy)); pos = fract((floor(mod(pos, tile))+vec2(0.5))/tile)-vec2(0.5);
name: Color Tiler

outputs.description: Shows a random color for each instance of the input image
outputs.label: Instance Map

parameters.description: The number of columns of the tiles pattern
parameters.label: Tile X
parameters.name: tx

parameters.description: The number of rows of the tiles pattern
parameters.label: Tile Y
parameters.name: ty

parameters.description: The number of neighbour tiles an instance of the input image can overlap. Set this parameter to the lowest value that generates the expected result (where all instances are fully visible) to improve performance.
parameters.label: Overlap
parameters.name: overlap

parameters.description:
The input type of the node:
- 1: single image
- 4: atlas of 4 images
- 16: atlas of 16 images
Atlases can be created using the Tile2x2 node.
parameters.label: Inputs
parameters.name: select_inputs

parameters.description: The scale of input images on the X axis
parameters.label: Scale X
parameters.name: scale_x

parameters.description: The scale of input images on the Y axis
parameters.label: Scale Y
parameters.name: scale_y

parameters.description: The relative offset of odd rows
parameters.label: Fixed Offset
parameters.name: fixed_offset

parameters.description: The random rotation applied to each image instance
parameters.label: Rnd Rotate
parameters.name: rotate

parameters.description: The random scale applied to each image instance
parameters.label: Rnd Scale
parameters.name: scale

parameters.description: The random opacity applied to each image instance
parameters.label: Rnd Opacity
parameters.name: opacity

parameters.description: Check to tile variations of the input
parameters.label: Variations
parameters.name: variations
